authority_notes: Plan-17 R1-R3 contract surfaces only. The registry is an in-memory contract whose tracked seed carries four hold:od-10.* authority sentinels: every mutating authorization fails closed (authority_unresolved_od10) and registryReadiness reports HOLD until the Owner records the OD-10 decisions. The resolver is not source truth, task, acceptance, or promotion authority; delete/move are globally gated to the R7 migration leaf. The materializer creates empty directories only under an exact Owner-approved empty canary root (no ref -> HOLD), moves zero payload bytes, and its rollback removes only still-empty directories from its own receipt. The storage map is a read-only registry-driven projection: missing evidence renders unknown or hold, never green, and rows carry no writer, raw-body, credential, or absolute-path fields. No live writer, collector, filesystem guard hook, or 4192 wiring is activated by this module.
